snippet.title: The Mad Merchant Demo is now available!
snippet.description:
Build, expand, and defend your moving fortress as you travel between distant settlements in a harsh industrial world. Manage production chains, trade valuable goods, complete contracts, and survive dangerous journeys on the rails.
